title: How to break off an engagement

sets.what: black space the tambourine tumbles through after leaving the living-room window (continues 02)

empty stone chapel: rose window high on the west wall, empty choir stands, empty prayer lines (kneelers), wooden pews, abandoned dry baptism pool; dressed in three time-lapse states (intact, cobwebbed, rotting)
outside the chapel's side doors: stone step, opened gift boxes left on it
the chapel from outside and in during a heavy storm: lightning, driving rain, roof failing, floodwater carrying goods out
after the storm: chapel remnants (pew ends, rose-window lead, stones) strewn on a mud shore; a pool that did not drain; two trails of footprints leading inland

scenes.lines: Ode to forever— / a tambourine sounds off an / empty temple, / empty choir stands, / empty prayer lines
scenes.treatment: Tambourine falling, flying, tumbling through black space.

shots.action: the tambourine thrown in 02 tumbles end over end through black space, jingles flashing
its jingle sounds off the empty temple: empty choir stands, empty prayer lines, dust in the window light
the empty choir stands, one music stand still upright

scenes.treatment: Tambourine files into chapel through window, still whole. [style: time-lapse photo-realistic] Chapel decay, close-ups.

shots.action: the tambourine flies in through the rose window, the glass letting it pass, still whole, and hangs in the air over the nave

props.state: whole, gliding through the rose window

shots.action: the abandoned baptism pool: dry, cracked tile, leaves in the drain; time-lapse begins
the tambourine suspended mid-air while the light races across the nave behind it (days passing)

scenes.lines: pews taken / by cobwebs— / & doused in / disintegration / spirits have / left salvations / in opened gift / boxes placed / outside the side doors—

shots.action: time-lapse: cobwebs spin across the pews row by row; varnish dulls and flakes
a hymnal on a pew disintegrates to dust page by page
outside the side doors: gift boxes sit opened on the step, their lids off, faint light rising out of them where the spirits left salvations

scenes.lines: it thunders. / then rains until / nothing remains. / what was once love / now goods— / broken & sealed apart / by lightning. / daily breads, / soaked & delivered rotted / by rain— / & blankets, / soiled by venomous / puppeteers,
scenes.treatment: Heavy storm takes over, speeds decay.

shots.action: lightning splits the chapel; rain drives through the failing roof; decay accelerates
goods broken and sealed apart: a wrapped wedding gift cracked in two by a lightning strike, halves scorched
daily breads soaked, swelling and rotting in the rain on the altar step
blankets soiled in the mud, tangled in cut marionette strings

scenes.lines: Ode to the storm ending. / ode to two sets of / mud imprinted footsteps—
scenes.treatment: Storm ends, remnants of chapel on shore.

shots.action: the storm lifts off to the north-east; chapel remnants lie on the mud shore by a pool that did not drain
two sets of footprints press into the mud one at a time, out of step, leading away from the pool

props.state: two trails, arriving one print at a time

shots.action: far up the trail, the two who made them walk away side by side, both with their backs to us

bodies.action: walks away inland on the left trail
walks away on the right trail, a step ahead

scenes.treatment: Tambourine finally lands on ground of chapel remnants and shatters. (Bridge to Nevermore: "What if I followed this trail to where the broken pieces have washed ashore")

shots.action: the tambourine finally falls out of the sky onto the chapel remnants

props.state: falling, whole for the last time

shots.action: it shatters: rim splits, skin tears, jingles scatter across the stones
following the trail at walking height: the broken pieces lie washed along the waterline, leading down the shore

props.state: strung along the waterline like a trail

props.what: the same wooden-rimmed tambourine from 02, whole
tambourine shards: split rim arcs, torn skin, loose brass jingles
tiered wooden choir stands with music stands
sunken tiled baptism pool, dry and cracked
oak chapel pews in three decay states
white wedding gift boxes with ribbon, lids off
round daily-bread loaves, soaking and rotting
black marionette strings and a cross-bar control
pew ends, rose-window lead tracery, stones, a cross
two trails of mud footprints, out of step

new_parts: tambourine: hero intact + breakaway shattered version and pieces (continuity from 02, into 04)
chapel interior in three time-lapse decay states + storm version
poet black_tshirt and man ex_jacket walking-away (back) figures, small in frame

sets: black void, chapel interior, side doors, storm exterior, remnants shore
